rule_cards.issue: Historical elements and reach of Delhi Rent Control Act, 1958 Section 14(1)(b)
rule_cards.proposition: For the version quoted and applied in this judgment, a tenant is liable for eviction under Section 14(1)(b) when, on or after 9 June 1952, the tenant sub-lets, assigns, or otherwise parts with possession of the whole or any part of the premises without the landlord's consent in writing. The three transfer modes are disjunctive. The Court further treated voluntariness and the tenant's reasons for the transfer as irrelevant to applicability.

The Court treated the transferor as having ceased to exist from the appointed day and the transferee as thereafter possessing the premises. Court sanction and an asserted law-compliance purpose did not create an exception from Section 14(1)(b).

rule_cards.issue: Specific written landlord consent for sub-letting under Section 14(1)(b)
